issues.reason: The naming rule requires the entity's kind in an ordinary type atom, and `address` is readable off the expression's own form (street number + avenue name) rather than off knowledge of that particular place, while the `addr_` prefix still leaves one stable, unsplit, name-derived symbol carrying the exact `Name` string — nothing false, ill-typed or over-asserted, in territory (a numeral-initial name) the instruction set does not cover.
`Ongoing` has exactly four licensed markers and a reduced-relative participle ("a person requesting assistance") is none of them, so the atom asserts progressive aspect the clause never marks.

The role rules keep a stative transitive subject on `Agent` unless the verb is possession or stative psych/perception, and "assistance regards a disturbance" is neither, so `Experiencer` mis-slots the subject as the holder of a psych state.

The bare-class licence is for unmodified non-specific objects ("pays tax", "speaks French"); here "assistance" carries a restrictive reduced relative, and putting the kind symbol in that event's subject slot would predicate the regarding of assistance at large — the witness plus its class atom is true and well-typed.

gaps_confirmed: plain simultaneity "when" joining two simple-past clauses — the time sections assign canonical forms to after/before/during/while but none to bare "when", so the link between the incident beginning and the call is lost

episodic bare-plural subject ("Deputies said …") — bare plurals are routed to generic rules or kind-level `Inheritance`, with no route for a bare plural naming specific participants in a one-off past event
new_gaps: a numeral-initial proper name (a street address) — nothing states how to form its symbol, and no kind word appears in the text to fill the type atom the naming rule requires
repair_summary: Removed the unlicensed (Ongoing sk_request_1) from the sealed complement; re-slotted the "regarding" reduced relative's subject from `Experiencer` to `Agent` per the stative-transitive rule.
notes: Sealing, projection of the definite incident and the named address, and the two compound genus atoms are all correct; the two refuted issues concern symbol form and witness choice, neither of which puts anything false into the KB.
